messages:
zoe-partnerops: Heads-up: VoltWare (hardware partner) wants to onboard. They emit millisecond-resolution events with per-device counters; marketplace needs hourly entitlements. Need ingest design + reconciliation approach. cc @ken-eng @maria-billing
ken-eng: Do they include a monotonic batch_id? Any sample?
zoe-partnerops: Sample they sent: ```{
  "device": "vw-77",
  "sku": "volt-mini",
  "ts": "2026-05-02T11:23:45.678Z",
  "ms_used": 1500,
  "batch_id": "batch-20260502-1123"
}``` They push every 2 minutes to S3 and call our webhook.
maria-billing: Billing rule: convert ms to seconds (floor), aggregate seconds per UTC hour, convert to minutes using ceil only at invoice stage. Must avoid double-counting on replay. Require idempotency by batch_id and partner_id.
ken-eng: Plan: ingest adapter will normalize timestamps to second granularity, dedupe by (device, second, sku), write raw to cold S3 (retain 90 days), then roll up to hourly minutes. Late arrival policy?
zoe-partnerops: VoltWare requests 72h backfill window; our marketplace policy is 48h. Suggest auto-accept 48h, flag 48-72h for ops review and manual reconciliation. Communicate clearly in onboarding doc.
leo-ps: Product wants seller-portal to expose a "raw events" debug view and an "adjustment_reason" tag for hours changed post-cut. Also support daily diff webhooks for partners who opt in.
deploy-bot: webhook-delivery: voltware-webhook returned 5xx for reconciliation-run run-20260502-11 at 2026-05-03T03:01:12Z - retry queued
ken-eng: Reconciliation: nightly job compares partner aggregates vs our rolled-up hours, emits diffs with schema run_id,hour_start,sku,partner_minutes,our_minutes,delta_minutes,reason_code. Tolerance: <=1 minute or <=0.5% -> no action; else open partner ops ticket.
maria-billing: Invoicing: only include final entitlements as of billing cut. Post-cut deltas flow as credits on next invoice and flagged with reason_code. Ensure idempotency prevents credits duplication.
zoe-partnerops: Action items: @ken-eng spike adapter + dedupe logic, @maria-billing add reconciliation playbook, I'll schedule sandbox test with VoltWare.
